children: Gareth Nichol disclosed a 20.17% stake in DynaResource, Inc.’s common stock. The Schedule 13D filed Sep. 03, 2026 follows his Sept. 1 purchase of 2,000,000 units, each with a share and a warrant. He also signed a voting agreement to support a share authorization change that would allow his warrants to be exercised.

Nichol says he bought the stake for investment and has no specific plans for changes at the company right now. He agreed to "vote ... in favor of the Amendment" that would either increase authorized shares or enable a reverse split so the company has enough stock to cover his warrant and other obligations. The units cost $0.45 each and include a warrant to buy additional shares at $0.51, but that warrant needs shareholder approval and a charter change before it can be used.

His warrant will become exercisable only after shareholders approve the change and the company files the amendment, with an exercise window that runs until the later of 180 days from issuance or 30 days after approval. Nichol "acquired the Units for investment purposes" and keeps the option to talk with management, buy more shares, exercise his rights, or sell in the future, depending on what he thinks is best.

Gareth Nichol is a retired investor with dual citizenship in the United States and Australia. He resides in Greenwood Village, Colorado. He invests his personal funds and, in this transaction, paid $0.45 per unit for shares and a warrant with a $0.51 exercise price.

title: Gareth Nichol Discloses Investment at DynaResource with 20.17% Stake
